scope: Capacity sample validation, no controller or admission change

reproduction.basis: Existing native EnvironmentCapacityTelemetryTest uses invocations at 1010 and 1160 ms.
reproduction.before: Reporter rejects stalled + missed > scheduler even though missed intervals are unobserved slots, not scheduler invocations.

repair: Bound stalled ticks by observed scheduler ticks independently; preserve nonnegative missed intervals without imposing that incorrect subset relation.
remaining_caveat: Continuous-control ratio remains the fraction of observed scheduler invocations, not wall-clock motion availability; missed intervals are reported separately.
